title: Z.AI and Atlas Cloud missing from the image/video provider list
reality: v2.4.0 (#4350) added Z.AI as a NATIVE Image Generation service with GLM-Image and CogView 4, model-aware aspect-ratio sizing, authenticated native requests, and safe local storage of returned image URLs. v2.3.5 (#3989) added Atlas Cloud as an image AND video generation service with curated starter models, text/reference image requests, async job polling, connection tests, and Game/scene-video routing. references/architecture.md line 249 still lists image gen as 'Pollinations, Stability AI, Together AI, NovelAI, Venice.ai, ComfyUI, AUTOMATIC1111' — neither is present. architecture.md mentions Z.AI only as a TEXT connection (GLM-5.2).
fix: Add Z.AI (GLM-Image, CogView 4) and Atlas Cloud to the 'Image gen:' line in references/architecture.md, and add Atlas Cloud to the Video Generation subsection since it routes Game/scene video too. Note the Z.AI distinction explicitly: Z.AI already appeared as a text provider, so a reader could reasonably conclude image support did not exist.

title: Krea routing through OpenRouter Images API not noted
reality: v2.4.0 (#4061) routed Krea models through OpenRouter's dedicated Images API while retaining image-only modality detection for every current `krea/` model.
fix: Add a parenthetical to the OpenRouter entry in the provider list of references/architecture.md. Low severity, but it explains why a `krea/` model behaves as image-only and is otherwise a confusing support case.

title: Conversation character schedule export/import missing
reality: v2.4.0 (#4414) added validated JSON export and import for Conversation character schedules. Imports load as unsaved DRAFTS, preserve the existing schedule until explicitly saved, and move restored routines to the current week.
fix: Document in references/architecture.md (character schedule / Conversation section) and cross-reference from character-cards.md, which already covers the schedule field. The draft-until-saved and shift-to-current-week semantics are both non-obvious and worth stating.

title: Home New Chat launcher not documented
reality: v2.4.0 (#4058) added a compact New Chat launcher to Home that explains Conversation, Roleplay, and Game before opening the selected mode's existing setup wizard. references/architecture.md has no match for it.
fix: Add to the Home/onboarding material in references/architecture.md. Relevant to first-run guidance now that mode choice is surfaced up front.

title: Android status bar control missing
reality: v2.3.5 added an Android-only 'Show Android status bar' control under Settings > General > App Behavior, preserving fullscreen as the default while letting the Android app remember and restore time, battery, and notification icons across restarts.
fix: Add to the Android/platform notes in references/architecture.md. Low severity; a concrete answer to a recurring Android usability question.

title: Noodle mobile-layout and handle-uniqueness changes not captured
reality: v2.4.0: Noodle and NoodleR switch to mobile layouts whenever the CENTER PANE falls below desktop width — including when sidebars shrink it on a desktop device (not just on a phone). v2.4.0 (#4056) enforced case-insensitive globally unique public Noodle handles across Personas and Characters, with deterministic suffixes for auto-created profiles and reconciliation of older collisions. v2.4.0 (#4310) skips corrupt/undecodable Noodle timeline images before captioning rather than forwarding invalid bytes.
fix: Add these to the Noodle section of references/architecture.md. The handle-uniqueness rule is the most useful: it explains auto-suffixed handles on personas/characters, which users read as a bug.
